name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Your Perpetuus API key, starting with `ppt_`. In Perpetuus, go to **Settings → API Tokens e MCP → Conectar sua IA (MCP) → Conectar editor → Conectar novo editor**, choose the validity and the `crm:write` scope (it includes `crm:read`). "Watch new messages" also needs the `chat:read` scope (or `chat:write`, which includes it), so select it too if you use that trigger. The key is shown only once.
